text:
Jamie: Quick heads-up — ran the weekly docs-garden scan and it flagged ~42 low-effort broken refs (images 403, shortlink redirects, and a handful of orphan anchors). Thinking we do a small "gardening" pass in this sprint to clear the obvious ones. Ping owners and volunteers. :seedling:

Arjun: Do we have the raw scan output or a short list? can triage quickly.

docs-bot: Scan report uploaded: https://internal.corp/snapshots/docs-garden/2701234567-report.csv (public to org). Summary: 42 total, 28 image issues, 9 shortlinks, 5 anchors.

Liz: I can take image 1–15 (mostly marketing assets). Will open PRs tomorrow. :raised_hands:

Jamie: amazing, thanks Liz. Arjun — if you can paste the commands for the quick replace we used last time that would help volunteers.

Arjun: sure. for rehosting broken images we used ripgrep + a tiny script, e.g.:
```bash
rg "!\[.*\]\((/old-cdn/|https://old-host.example)" -n docs/ | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u > images-to-fix.txt
# then a small python script to upload and replace URLs in PRs
```

Maya: for shortlinks (tiny.do style) is it okay to 301 -> canonical, or should we rehost/replace with full URL?

Jamie: prefer replace with canonical internal doc path when available; otherwise 301 via our shortlink service is fine. The goal is to avoid transient external redirects.

Liz: FYI I'll label PRs with `docs:gardening` and `area:marketing`. Also adding a short changelog in PR body linking the scan row.

Arjun: I'll take anchors 1–5. Quick question — do we have an owner mapping for older KB pages? some look unowned.

docs-bot: Owner mapping available: https://internal.corp/docs/owners-map.csv — flagged pages without owners in column `owner` as `UNASSIGNED`.

Maya: I can pick up unassigned pages in `developer-experience` and `kb/runbooks` — will claim in the owners map.

SprintCoord: This seems like low-effort/high-value. Suggest we treat each PR as ~0.5–1pt and cap the sprint at 8 pts. I'll add a short ticket `DOCS-503: docs garden sprint` and include sub-tasks for each volunteer.

Jamie: thanks — could we also add a very short PR template snippet to remind folks to check for redirects and add tests where possible? example: `Checklist: rehosted images / no external shortlinks / anchors resolved / linkcheck passed`.

Arjun: added a tiny script snippet for local linkcheck in the docs repo: `python tools/linkcheck.py --paths images-to-fix.txt`.

Liz: PR opened for images 1–8: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/1842 — includes the changelog and screenshots of updated pages.

Jamie: nice. tagging @Maya to double-check `kb/runbooks` pages in that PR if relevant.

Maya: will review tomorrow morning.

Arjun: claiming anchors 1–5 now, will push small fixes and tag `@Jamie` for a quick review.

Jamie: awesome team. if anyone else wants a quick win ping me here and I'll assign a sub-task on the sprint ticket. :thumbsup:
